moments.tail:
# Answer
Write only a JSON array, nothing else. Best moment first, at most {n}, no overlaps:
[{"start": seconds, "end": seconds, "punch": second the punchline starts, "score": 0-10 how funny, "title": "short title", "why": "why it is funny, one sentence"}]

passages.head:
The speaker's voice goes over a music edit (sad edit / viral edit). Pick the best {n} of these passages.
Good: understandable alone, needs no context, strong feeling or claim, ends on a line that sticks.
Bad: half an idea, mentions the screen/link/subscribing/sponsor, a list of technical steps.
passages.tail: Write only a JSON array, best first, at most {n} numbers: [3, 0, 7]

videos.head: Pick the {n} of these videos that make the best material for a music edit (sad edit / viral edit). Good: strong, memorable, emotional talk and interesting pictures. Skip boring, technical, list-reading videos.
videos.tail: Write only a JSON array, best first, {n} numbers: [2, 0]

lines.head: Pick the best {n} sentences to show as text over a sad / viral edit: meaningful alone, strong feeling, memorable. Skip technical ones and ones that need context.
lines.tail: Write only a JSON array, the {n} numbers in the order to show them: [4, 1, 9]

vod.head:
You choose which moments of a long video become short clips (TikTok, Reels, Shorts). Video: {title}

Each candidate below was found by its signals: how loud it got against the whole video, reactions said out loud, how hard the chat went. Judge each by what was said and what the chat did.

Drop first, whatever else: the story's ending or a plot spoiler, sexual content, hate speech, gambling or crypto promotion, a moment that needs an hour of context.
Score the rest 0-3 on each of: hook (the first 3 seconds make you stay), payoff (something happens), reaction (someone reacts out loud), stands alone (no context needed), reads on a phone, new (not the same bit again), suitable (nothing a platform punishes). Keep 12 of 21 or more.
Cut each: start on the hook, not on setup chatter; end on the last word of the reaction; 20-45 s, never over 90.

# Candidates
vod.tail:
# Answer
Only a JSON array, best first, at most {n}: every candidate you keep (12 or more), none you drop.
[{"id": candidate number, "start": seconds, "end": seconds, "score": 0-21, "title": "short title in the video's language", "why": "one line", "post": "the post's caption in the video's language: one line and 3-5 hashtags"}]

translate.ask:
Translate each line of this JSON array into {to}, the way someone speaking {to} would say it out loud: keep slang, swearing, names and gamer talk, never explain. The first line is a short title; keep it short. Answer only a JSON array of strings, the same number of lines in the same order.

{lines}
